notes: Assemblies of God congregation on E Broadway near Campbell. Website found on 2026-09-10: firstassemblytucson.com (Wix). The site footer confirms the address 1749 E Broadway Blvd, Tucson AZ 85719; lat/lng were left as the existing estimate (geocode 'approximate') because the address did not change - re-run tools/geocode.py to upgrade them. The About Us page names 'Reverend Jim Munns' as Pastor, the only person on that page given a pastoral title (the rest are music, youth, children's, nursery and media team members), so he is recorded as the sole preaching pastor. Sermon media is awkward: the 'First Services: Live and Replay' page embeds a Wix Video channel called 'First Assembly Tucson' whose iframe failed to load when checked, and the separate /sermons page had no visible links. The Christian World Media live channel is confirmed live and active (latest entries 'Sunday Morning, We welcome you' dated 1/25/2026, 2/01/2026 and 2/08/2026, with Sunday 10:45am and Wednesday 7pm Bible study) but CWM has no captions, so a review would need audio download plus local transcription, and it is unclear how far back the CWM archive reaches. No YouTube channel was found. Before planning a review, open the Wix video channel in a real browser and check how many past services are retrievable.
